interventions.description: Fast-growing shade tree alignment & permeable tree pits (SUDS)
interventions.notes: Reduces urban heat island, retains stormwater and sequesters 260 kg CO2/yr per 100m

interventions.description: Tensile shade sails / Bioclimatic canopy at traffic light waiting box
interventions.notes: Immediate relief at red-light waiting hotspots; removable in winter

interventions.description: Cyclist Oasis Micro-Shelter (Green pergola + Chilled fountain + Mist + Bench)
interventions.notes: Ideal for industrial estate, hospital route and Agrarian Park greenway

interventions.description: High-albedo solar reflective coating (Cool Pavement) on cycle lane
interventions.notes: Prevents asphalt from reaching 48 °C and radiating heat upward in the afternoon

interventions.description: Heat-triggered cyclist green-wave traffic light priority sensor
interventions.notes: When T > 28 °C, cuts cyclist waiting time in the sun from 65s to <15s

interventions.description: Photovoltaic shade canopy for AMBici / Bicibox station
interventions.notes: Keeps bike saddles cool, charges e-bikes with solar power and avoids 1,150 kg CO2e/yr

modal_shift_reference.solution_description: Modal shift reference (Combustion car trip replaced by bicycle)
modal_shift_reference.notes: Each summer trip kept on a bike instead of a car avoids 0.72 kg CO2e and saves €1.15
